description: Approximately five minutes of random wandering with random turns and halts.

Walk to a chair, sit down, remain seated for a short interval, stand up, and return; repeated approximately 50 times. The participant performs the sequence while facing the sensor, with the participant’s left side facing the sensor, and with the participant’s right side facing the sensor, with repetitions distributed approximately evenly across the three orientations.

Walk to a sofa or bed, lie down, remain lying for a short interval, get up, and return; repeated approximately 50 times. The participant performs the sequence with either the participant’s left side or right side facing the sensor, with repetitions distributed approximately evenly across the two orientations.

Walk to the center of the room, fall, remain lying on the floor for a short interval, stand up, and return; repeated approximately 50 times. The participant performs the sequence while facing the sensor, with the participant’s left side facing the sensor, and with the participant’s right side facing the sensor, with repetitions distributed approximately evenly across the three orientations.
